description: This source file defines the implementation of the AdoNetRemindersProviderBuilder class, which is responsible for configuring ADO.NET based reminder services in an Orleans silo. It includes a class implementing the IProviderBuilder interface with a Configure method that sets up connection parameters for the reminder service based on configuration settings.

classes.name: AdoNetRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder for configuring ADO.NET reminder services in an Orleans silo. It contains a method to set up connection options based on configuration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ADO.NET reminder service by setting the invariant, connection string, and connection name based on provided configuration section and services.
